page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and designed for high-density computational tasks. It runs on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz, providing 192 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration delivers 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The server does not include GPU accelerators or local storage disks, necessitating network-attached storage solutions for persistent data needs.

Networking capabilities are defined by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating high-throughput node-to-node communication. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which means external connectivity relies on separately provisioned networking services. With 192 dedicated vCPUs, CPU resource contention is eliminated, making it capable of handling large multithreaded jobs smoothly.

From an efficiency standpoint, the compute-to-memory profile prioritizes pure CPU throughput over expansive RAM allocation, reducing memory overhead costs for workloads that do not require high memory-per-core ratios. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local disk IOPS and integrated hardware accelerators. This instance profile fits large-scale batch processing, parallel code compilation, scientific simulations, video transcode pipelines, and CPU-bound container orchestrations.
